description: Read the native QIE balance and known token balances for an address on QIE mainnet (chain 1990) or testnet (chain 1983). Pass a checksummed or all-lowercase hex address. A QIE ID such as yourname.qie is accepted on mainnet and is resolved the same way as qie_resolve_name; if it does not resolve, the status is unresolved and no balance is invented. Amounts are raw integers plus a decimal formatting of those integers. This tool does not give price, APY, returns, yield, or investment advice and will decline such questions.

address.description: A 20-byte hex address, or a QIE ID such as yourname.qie (mainnet).

include_tokens.description: When true, include token balances reported by the network explorer. Defaults to true.

network.description: Pinned network. mainnet is chain 1990 and testnet is chain 1983. Defaults to mainnet. A raw chain ID or RPC URL is not accepted.

name: qie_get_balances
title: Get QIE balances
